scripts.generate-api: cd .. && uv run --project python python python/scripts/generate_api_docs.py
scripts.check-generated: cd .. && uv run --project python python python/scripts/generate_api_docs.py --check && uv run --project python python python/scripts/generate_teaching_traces.py --check
scripts.build: npm run check-generated && npm run check-content && npm run prepare-content && astro build
scripts.check: npm run check-generated && npm run check-content && npm run prepare-content && astro check
